hero_image.description: Happy Indian family for hero section to establish human trust

advisor_image.description: Human advisor meeting with client, representing personalized guidance

family_support_image.description: Family portrait for long-term relationships section

process_image.description: Advisor talking to client on a bench, conveying human conversation

sections.name: Navigation
sections.guidelines: Sticky header with backdrop-blur. Logo on left (Deep Navy). Links centered: Services, Claims Support, About, Contact. Right: 'Talk to an Advisor' primary button.

sections.name: Hero
sections.guidelines: Split layout or highly engaging centered layout. Headline: 'Insurance advice from real people who care.' Subhead: 'No bots. No automated recommendations. Just experienced advisors helping you make confident insurance decisions.' Buttons: Primary 'Talk to an Advisor', Secondary 'Upload Existing Policy'. Use hero_image.

sections.name: Trust Strip
sections.guidelines: Horizontal bar with logos/icons and text: 15+ Years Experience, Human Insurance Advisors, Dedicated Claim Assistance, Transparent Guidance, Long-Term Support.

sections.name: How We Help
sections.guidelines: 3-column grid of cards. Understand, Recommend, Support. Subtle icons.

sections.name: Policy Review / Second Opinion
sections.guidelines: Distinct background section (maybe soft deep navy with white text, or pale sage). 'Get a second opinion on your insurance.' CTA to Upload PDF.

sections.name: Services
sections.guidelines: 6-card bento/grid layout for Health, Motor, Life, Business, Travel, Personal Accident. Use large outline icons (Phosphor). 'Learn More' ghost buttons.

sections.name: Comparison Table (Why RightPolicy)
sections.guidelines: Table highlighting 'Typical Online Platforms' vs 'RightPolicy Advisory'. Red X for typical platforms, Green Check for RightPolicy. Emphasize human advisors, claim assistance.

sections.name: Client Experience
sections.guidelines: Card grid focusing on client values: Clear explanations, Human guidance, Claim support, Long-term trust. Use warm photography.

sections.name: Impact Stats
sections.guidelines: Large numbers: 15+ Years, 1000+ Policies, Dedicated Claim Assistance, Long-Term Relationships.

sections.name: How It Works
sections.guidelines: 4-step horizontal or vertical timeline flow. Talk to an Advisor -> Get Personalized Guidance -> Choose with Confidence -> Ongoing Support.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.guidelines: Accordion pattern using Shadcn UI. 6 questions.

sections.name: Final CTA
sections.guidelines: Large prominent banner. 'Insurance decisions deserve human conversations.' Buttons: 'Talk to an Advisor', 'Upload Existing Policy'.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_requirements: WCAG AA minimum, check red against white and navy against off-white

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT create a fintech-style insurance marketplace.
Do NOT create an aggressive lead-generation website.
Design should feel calm, trustworthy, modern, premium, human-centered.
Use Phosphor Icons for a clean, outline look.
Implement the 'Upload Existing Policy' feature connecting to the backend.
Install and use 'framer-motion' for subtle scroll animations (fade in up).
Install Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' in index.html or global CSS.
